comparison.objective: Add and close a padlock through a group-lockout hasp without disturbing an existing lock.
comparison.physical_skill: Small shackle-to-hole alignment and snap closure around a freely moving hasp.
comparison.success_condition: Padlock remains shut and prevents hasp/handle motion under specified torque tests.
comparison.reason: The candidate tests handed long-rail support, spring-prong engagement at two separated posts, telescoping, leveling, and screw fastening—not padlock insertion. Candidate force and deformation limits remain unspecified.
